sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Avery Dennison sets the industry standard in vinyl graphic design and automotive wrap graphics worldwide, offering graphic solutions from architectural design to vehicle wraps and fleets.

Industry: Manufacturing · Size: $1B+ · Products: Cut Vinyl Films, Digitally Printable Films, Paint Protection Films, Vehicle Wrapping Films, Window Films, Application Tools

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions scores 76 of 100 (tier A) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (12/30), application fit (24/25), company size (15/15), event engagement (15/15) and pain-point alignment (10/15).

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on uv resistance, lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar PVF films hold colour and gloss through years of direct UV exposure. Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.
